Actor RSLDL_LDPermanentInventory : Inventory
{
//  +INVENTORY.UNDROPPABLE
  +INVENTORY.UNTOSSABLE
  +INVENTORY.IGNORESKILL
inventory.maxamount 1
}

ACTOR RSLDL_LDCustomFunction : RSQMB_LDLFn
{
  -COUNTITEM
  +INVENTORY.ALWAYSPICKUP
  Inventory.PickupMessage ""
  Inventory.PickupSound ""
  States
  {
  Spawn:
    TNT1 A 1
    Stop
  Pickup:
    TNT1 A 0
	TNT1 A 0
    Stop
  }
}

actor RSLDL_LDVisualIcon
{
	Radius 16
	Height 8
    Scale 0.8
    Alpha 0.85
    RenderStyle Add
	+NOGRAVITY
	+THRUACTORS
	+NOTONAUTOMAP
    +NOTIMEFREEZE
    States
    {
    Spawn:
	    TNT1 AA 1 Bright
        Stop
    }
}

//==============================================================================
//			LEGENDARY GENERATION
//==============================================================================

// The steps a monster goes through to determine if it can be legendary or not
ACTOR RSLDL_LDLegendaryMonsterPickupEasy : RSLDL_LDCustomFunction
{
  States
  {
  Pickup:
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIf ((GetCVar("rsqmb_ldl_nomonsters") == 1), "GoddamnIneedMoreJumps") // Makes nothing legendary, I don't know why this is still here
    TNT1 A 0 A_CheckFlag ("BOSS", 2) // only bosses go here
    TNT1 A 0 A_Jump (256, 2) // so everything else should skip the next check
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIf ((GetCVar("rsqmb_ldl_nobosses") == 2), "BOSSCheckeroonie") // Makes all bosses legendary
    TNT1 A 0 A_CheckFlag ("SPECIAL", "GoddamnIneedMoreJumps") // To stop die.exe making items legendary
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIf ((GetCVar("rsqmb_ldl_diemode") == 1), "LEGENDARIFYSuccess") // Makes all enemies legendary
    TNT1 A 0 A_Jump (256, "DifficultyChance")
	Goto DifficultyChance
  DifficultyChance: // The chance of successfully becoming legendary is increased through player count and menu options
    TNT1 A 0 A_Jump ((RSQLDL_Players()*4) + (GetCVar("rsqmb_ldl_legendarychance")*5), "LEGENDARIFY")
    Stop
  LEGENDARIFY:
    TNT1 A 0 A_CheckFlag ("SPECIAL", "GoddamnIneedMoreJumps") // probably not needed here, but was an amusing thing from LegenDoom
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIf ((GetCVar("rsqmb_ldl_monstercheck") == 0), 2) // Makes it ignore the next check if disabled
    TNT1 A 0 A_CheckFlag ("COUNTKILL", 1) // Added to stop stupid shit like legendary trees
	Stop
    TNT1 A 0 A_CheckFlag ("BOSS", "BOSSTIEM") // Make bosses stronk
    TNT1 A 0 A_Jump (240, "GoddamnIneedMoreJumps")
	Goto LEGENDARIFYSuccess
  LEGENDARIFYSuccess: // Spawns map markers if active in the menu options
	TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIf(GetCVar("rsqmb_ldl_legendarymarkers") == 0, 2)
    TNT1 A 0 A_SpawnItemEx ("LDLegendaryMonsterMarker", 0,0,0, 0,0,0, 0, SXF_NOCHECKPOSITION)
	TNT1 A 0 RSQLDL_Init() // POWER UP TIME
    Stop
	
  BOSSCheckeroonie:
    TNT1 A 0 A_CheckFlag ("BOSS", "BOSSACTIVAAAATE")
    TNT1 A 0 A_Jump (256, "DifficultyChance")
	Goto DifficultyChance
  BOSSTIEM:
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIf ((GetCVar("rsqmb_ldl_nobosses") == 1), "GoddamnIneedMoreJumps") // Prevents bosses from being legendary
    TNT1 A 0 A_Jump (180, "GoddamnIneedMoreJumps")
	Goto BOSSACTIVAAAATE
  BOSSACTIVAAAATE: // Spawns map markers if active in the menu options
	TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIf(GetCVar("rsqmb_ldl_legendarymarkers") == 0, 2)
    TNT1 A 0 A_SpawnItemEx ("LDLegendaryMonsterBossMarker", 0,0,0, 0,0,0, 0, SXF_NOCHECKPOSITION)
	TNT1 A 0 RSQLDL_Init() // BRING THE PAIN
    Stop
	
  GoddamnIneedMoreJumps:
	TNT1 A 0
    Stop
  }
}

ACTOR LDLegendaryMonsterPickupNormal : RSLDL_LDLegendaryMonsterPickupEasy
{
  States
  {
  DifficultyChance:
    TNT1 A 0 A_Jump ((RSQLDL_Players()*6) + (GetCVar("rsqmb_ldl_legendarychance")*5), "LEGENDARIFY")
    Stop
  }
}

// Give this item to monsters to guarantee they turn legendary!
ACTOR LDLegendaryMonsterPickupGuaranteed : RSLDL_LDLegendaryMonsterPickupEasy
{
  States
  {
  Pickup:
    TNT1 A 0 A_Jump (256, "LEGENDARIFY")
	Goto LEGENDARIFY
  LEGENDARIFY:
    TNT1 A 0 A_CheckFlag ("SPECIAL", "GoddamnIneedMoreJumps") // probably not needed here, but was an amusing thing from LegenDoom
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIf ((GetCVar("rsqmb_ldl_monstercheck") == 0), 2) // Makes it ignore the next check if disabled
    TNT1 A 0 A_CheckFlag ("COUNTKILL", 1) // Added to stop stupid shit like legendary trees
	Stop
    TNT1 A 0 A_CheckFlag ("BOSS", "BOSSACTIVAAAATE") // Make bosses stronk
    TNT1 A 0 A_Jump (256, "LEGENDARIFYSuccess")
	Goto LEGENDARIFYSuccess
  }
}

// Gives the relevant stat multipliers and flags based on whether the monster is a boss or not
ACTOR LDLegendaryMonsterStatChooser : RSLDL_LDCustomFunction
{
  States
  {
  Pickup:
	TNT1 A 0 A_CheckFlag ("BOSS", "BossStatBoost")
	TNT1 A 0 A_GiveInventory ("LDLegendaryMonsterStatBoost", 1)
    Stop
  BossStatBoost:
	TNT1 A 0 A_GiveInventory ("LDLegendaryMonsterBossStatBoost", 1)
    Stop
  }
}

    Stop

    Stop
  }
}

	TNT1 A 0 A_GiveInventory ("LDLegendaryMonsterTransformed", 1)
	TNT1 A 0 A_GiveInventory ("LDLegendaryMonsterResistances", 1)

    TNT1 A 0 A_ChangeFlag ("ALWAYSFAST", 1)

    TNT1 A 0 A_ChangeFlag ("NOFEAR", 1)

// Removes the special effects from the legendary monsters on death
ACTOR LDLegendaryMonsterDed : RSLDL_LDCustomFunction
{
  States
  {
  Pickup:
//    TNT1 A 0 A_SpawnItemEx ("LDLegendaryMonsterEvolveEffect", 5,0,0, 0,0,0, 0, SXF_NOCHECKPOSITION)
    TNT1 A 0 A_StopSound (6)
    TNT1 A 0 A_ChangeFlag ("BRIGHT", 0)
    Stop
  }
}

// Constantly alternates visuals based on maxhax funtiems
ACTOR LDLegendaryMonsterVisualEffectMaker : RSLDL_LDCustomFunction
{
  States
  {
  Pickup:
    // Champions compatibility
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIfInventory ("champion_DarkRedToken", 	1, "DarkRedEffects")
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIfInventory ("champion_RedToken", 		1, "RedEffects")
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIfInventory ("champion_OrangeToken", 	1, "OrangeEffects")
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIfInventory ("champion_YellowToken", 	1, "YellowEffects")
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIfInventory ("champion_DarkGreenToken", 	1, "DarkGreenEffects")
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIfInventory ("champion_GreenToken", 		1, "GreenEffects")
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIfInventory ("champion_CyanToken", 		1, "CyanEffects")
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIfInventory ("champion_BlueToken", 		1, "BlueEffects")
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIfInventory ("champion_IndigoToken", 	1, "IndigoEffects")
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIfInventory ("champion_VioletToken", 	1, "VioletEffects")
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIfInventory ("champion_PinkToken", 		1, "PinkEffects")
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIfInventory ("champion_MagentaToken", 	1, "MagentaEffects")
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIfInventory ("champion_BlackToken", 		1, "BlackEffects")
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIfInventory ("champion_GreyToken", 		1, "GreyEffects")
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIfInventory ("champion_WhiteToken", 		1, "WhiteEffects")
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIfInventory ("champion_BronzeToken", 	1, "BronzeEffects")
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIfInventory ("champion_SilverToken", 	1, "SilverEffects")
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIfInventory ("champion_GoldToken", 		1, "GoldEffects")
	
  StandardEffects:
    TNT1 A 0 A_JumpIfInventory ("LDLegendaryMonsterVisualEffectAlternator", 1, "Pickup2")
    TNT1 A 0 A_GiveInventory ("LDLegendaryMonsterVisualEffectAlternator", 1)
    TNT1 A 0 A_SpawnItemEx ("LDLegendaryMonsterVisualEffectStandard", -1,0,0, 0,0,0, 0, SXF_NOCHECKPOSITION | SXF_TRANSFERSPRITEFRAME |  SXF_TRANSFERSCALE | SXF_TRANSFERALPHA)
	TNT1 AAA 0 A_SpawnParticle ("Red", SPF_FULLBRIGHT | SPF_RELPOS, random(5,35), random(1,5), 0, frandom(-(radius*1.1),(radius*1.1)),frandom(-(radius*1.1),(radius*1.1)), frandom(0,(height*1.1)), 0,0,frandom(0.05,1.8), 0,0,0.25, 0.8, -1)
    Stop
  Pickup2:
    TNT1 A 0 A_TakeInventory ("LDLegendaryMonsterVisualEffectAlternator", 1)
    TNT1 A 0 A_SpawnItemEx ("LDLegendaryMonsterVisualEffectStandard2", -1,0,0, 0,0,0, 0, SXF_NOCHECKPOSITION | SXF_TRANSFERSPRITEFRAME |  SXF_TRANSFERSCALE | SXF_TRANSFERALPHA)
	TNT1 AAA 0 A_SpawnParticle ("Black", SPF_FULLBRIGHT | SPF_RELPOS, random(5,35), random(1,5), 0, frandom(-(radius*1.1),(radius*1.1)),frandom(-(radius*1.1),(radius*1.1)), frandom(0,(height*1.1)), 0,0,frandom(0.05,1.8), 0,0,0.25, 0.8, -1)
    Stop
	
    // Champions compatibility
  DarkRedEffects:

	TNT1 AAA 0 A_SpawnParticle (800000, SPF_FULLBRIGHT | SPF_RELPOS, random(5,35), random(1,5), 0, frandom(-(radius*1.1),(radius*1.1)),frandom(-(radius*1.1),(radius*1.1)), frandom(0,(height*1.1)), 0,0,frandom(0.05,1.8), 0,0,0.25, 0.8, -1)
    Stop
  RedEffects:
    TNT1 A 0 A_SpawnItemEx ("LDLegendaryMonsterVisualEffectRed", -1,0,0, 0,0,0, 0, SXF_NOCHECKPOSITION | SXF_TRANSFERSPRITEFRAME |  SXF_TRANSFERSCALE | SXF_TRANSFERALPHA)

Actor LDLegendaryMonsterVisualEffectAlternator : RSLDL_LDPermanentInventory {}

actor RSLDL_LDLegendaryMonsterVisualEffectStandard : RSLDL_LDVisualIcon
{
    Scale 1.0
    Alpha 1.0
    RenderStyle AddStencil
	StencilColor "Red"
	-FORCEXYBILLBOARD
	-VISIBILITYPULSE
    +NOTIMEFREEZE
    States
    {
    Spawn:
	    "####" "#" 0 Bright
	    "####" "#" 0 Bright A_FadeTo (alpha * 0.5, 1, 0)
	    "####" "#" 0 Bright ThrustThingZ (0, 1, 0, 0)
	    "####" "#" 0 A_Jump (256, "SpawnLoop")
        Goto SpawnLoop
    SpawnLoop:
	    "####" "#" 0 Bright A_FadeTo (0, 0.12, 1)
        "####" "#" 1 Bright A_SetScale (scalex, scaley*frandom(1.02,1.04))
        Goto SpawnLoop
    }
}

{

	StencilColor "Black"
    States

        "####" "#" 1 Bright A_SetScale (scalex, scaley*frandom(1.02,1.04))
        Goto SpawnLoop
    }
}

//==============================================================================
//			LEGENDARY MAP MARKERS
//==============================================================================

// These appear on the automap if enabled in the options
ACTOR LDLegendaryMonsterMarker : MapMarker
{
  Scale 0.3
  States
  {
  Spawn:
    SCUL A -1
    Stop
  }
}

ACTOR LDLegendaryMonsterBossMarker : MapMarker
{
  Scale 0.8
  States
  {
  Spawn:
    SCUL B -1
    Stop
  }
}
